tagline: Providing private mortgage insurance to help qualified borrowers achieve homeownership while mitigating credit risk for lenders
hero_kpi_rationale: Risk-In-Force (RIF) is the primary indicator of the actual size of the insured portfolio and the underlying risk covered, making it the fundamental driver of NMIH's value and growth trajectory in the mortgage insurance sector.

kpis.name: Risk-In-Force (RIF)
kpis.explanation: Total amount of risk the company covers on insured loans.
kpis.description: RIF reflects the company's potential liability in case of default. It is influenced by the volume of new insured loans and their LTV profile.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in insured portfolio size

kpis.name: Insurance-In-Force (IIF)
kpis.explanation: Total amount of residential loans currently insured by the company.
kpis.description: IIF represents the future insurance premium revenue base. It grows with new insured loans and declines with repayments.

kpis.name: New Insurance Written (NIW)
kpis.explanation: Total value of new loans insured over a year.
kpis.description: NIW measures annual underwriting activity. It depends on the housing market and the company's market share.
kpis.signal: Significant annual flow of new insured loans

kpis.name: Number of lender customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of banks and lenders with which the company has an active contract.
kpis.description: A large and diversified customer base strengthens business resilience and growth capacity.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time and part-time employees.
kpis.description: A moderate workforce supports a highly specialized private mortgage insurance operation.
kpis.signal: Lean and efficient structure for a mortgage insurance operation

kpis.name: New lenders activated
kpis.explanation: Number of new lenders that began using the company's insurance during the year.
kpis.description: Activations reflect the company's ability to convert agreements into actual business activity. A decline of 23.7% compared to 118 in 2024 may indicate market slowdown or increased competition.
kpis.signal: Slowing pace in acquiring new customers

kpis.name: Number of lender customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of banks and lenders with which the company has an active contract.
kpis.description: A large and diversified customer base strengthens business resilience and growth capacity. The portfolio includes national and regional banks, credit unions, and non-bank lenders.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company highlights its proprietary Rate GPS platform for risk assessment and dynamic pricing, but does not explicitly reference AI. Rate GPS is described as a risk-based pricing platform that evaluates a broad range of stratified risk variables.
evidence: Reference to Rate GPS as a proprietary risk-based pricing platform assessing borrower credit, loan attributes, products, lenders, and geographic factors
No direct reference to AI, machine learning, or AI APIs
Focus on individual loan analysis and foundational principles, not cutting-edge technological innovation
